body: The Boeing Company recorded third-quarter 2026 revenue of $24.2 billion, up 4% from $23.3 billion a year earlier, primarily reflecting higher defense and services volume and a less favorable commercial delivery mix. The company reported a GAAP loss per share of $0.26, compared with $7.14 a year earlier, and a net loss of $116 million, compared with $5,339 million. Operating cash flow was $1.5 billion and free cash flow was $0.5 billion, while total company backlog grew to a record $745 billion, including over 6,300 commercial airplanes.

In Commercial Airplanes, third-quarter revenue was $10.7 billion on 161 deliveries, with 300 net orders booked including orders from Turkish Airlines, Ethiopian Airlines and Lufthansa; the commercial backlog included over 6,300 airplanes valued at a record $612 billion. During the quarter, the 737-7 achieved amended type certification from the FAA and the 737-10 achieved certification in October, the 737 program continued toward stabilized production of 47 per month, and the 787 program remained stable at 8 per month, while the 777X program remained on track for first delivery in 2027. Boeing was also selected by the U.S. Navy to design, build and deliver the F/A-XX next-generation fighter aircraft.
en.summary: Boeing reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $24.2 billion and a net loss of $116 million, with total company backlog growing to a record $745 billion.
en.title: Boeing reports third-quarter 2026 results with record $745 billion backlog

body: 波音2026年第三季營收242億美元，較去年同期的233億美元成長4%，主要反映國防與服務業務量增加，以及商用交付組合較不利。公司本季依一般公認會計原則每股虧損0.26美元，去年同期為7.14美元；淨虧損1.16億美元，去年同期為53.39億美元。營運現金流15億美元，自由現金流5億美元，季底總積壓訂單增至創紀錄7,450億美元。

商用飛機部門第三季營收107億美元，交付161架飛機，淨接單300架，包括土耳其航空、衣索比亞航空與漢莎航空的訂單；商用積壓訂單逾6,300架，價值創紀錄6,120億美元。本季737-7獲得美國聯邦航空總署修訂型別認證，737-10於10月獲得認證；737計畫持續朝每月穩定生產47架邁進，787計畫維持每月8架的穩定生產速率，777X計畫則維持2027年首架交付的目標。波音亦獲美國海軍選定設計、建造與交付F/A-XX次世代戰鬥機。
